map.这个工具怎么用？: How do I use this tool?
map.在对应输入框填入参数，结果区会即时给出计算结果。: Enter the parameters in the fields; the result area updates immediately.
map.输入公历日期即可换算农历、干支、生肖与节气，并查看当日历史事件；月历日期格支持键: Enter a Gregorian date to convert it to the Chinese lunar date, sexagenary year, zodiac sign and solar term, and see events for that day. Calendar day cells support keyboard focus and Enter/Space selection, with a visible highlight and screen-reader labels.
map.农历换算基于内置朔望月表，覆盖约 1900–2099 年；干支按“年份减 4”对: Lunar conversion uses a built-in new-moon table covering about 1900–2099. The sexagenary year takes (year − 4) modulo the ten stems and twelve branches, the zodiac follows the branch, and solar terms use an approximate solar-longitude calculation. Every date in the calendar is a real button: Tab moves focus and Enter or Space activates it; today has aria-current and the selected date has aria-pressed plus a highlight border.
map.查生日对应的农历日期、生肖与干支。: Look up the lunar date, zodiac sign and sexagenary year for a birthday.
map.备课时查某日节气，或看“历史上的今天”有哪些代表事件。: Check a date’s solar term for lesson preparation, or see representative events for that day.
map.只用键盘操作月历，检查前后月份并选中某一天。: Operate the calendar by keyboard only, move between months and select a day.
map.在日期框输入或选择公历日期，也可点示例按钮。: Enter or pick a Gregorian date, or use one of the example buttons.
map.用“上月/下月”翻月；日期格可用 Tab 聚焦，Enter 或空格选中。: Use “Previous/Next month” to change months; Tab focuses a day and Enter or Space selects it.
map.查看农历、干支、生肖、节气与距今天数。: Review the lunar date, sexagenary year, zodiac, solar term and days from today.
map.需要留存时分别导出“历法详情 CSV”或“历史事件 CSV”。: Export “Calendar details CSV” or “Historical events CSV” when you need a record.

map.2000-01-01 → 年减 4 为 1996，1996 mod 10 = 6: 2000-01-01 → year − 4 = 1996; 1996 mod 10 = 6 gives “Ji”, mod 12 = 4 gives “Mao”, so Ji-Mao year and zodiac Rabbit.
map.2024-06-21 为夏至；选中该日期后，日期格显示高亮边框，读屏标签为“20: 2024-06-21 is the Summer Solstice; selecting it adds a highlight border and the screen-reader label “June 21, 2024”.
map.农历表只覆盖约 1900–2099 年，超出范围会提示无法换算。干支与生肖采用按: The lunar table covers only about 1900–2099; dates outside that range are rejected. The sexagenary year and zodiac use the Gregorian year for simplicity; strict traditional reckoning uses the Start of Spring as the boundary. Historical events are a public selection, not a complete archive.
map.日期格能用键盘操作吗？: Can the date cells be operated by keyboard?
map.可以。每个日期都是按钮，Tab 可聚焦，Enter 或空格可选中；今天与选中状态: Yes. Each date is a button; Tab focuses it and Enter or Space selects it. Today and the selected state have corresponding aria attributes.
map.农历转换为什么有年份限制？: Why is lunar conversion limited to certain years?
map.内置朔望月数据只覆盖约 1900–2099 年，超出范围无法可靠推算，请改用专业: The built-in new-moon data covers only about 1900–2099; outside that range the conversion is unreliable. Use a professional perpetual calendar.
map.干支和生肖按哪个“年”算？: Which “year” is used for the sexagenary cycle and zodiac?
map.本工具按公历年份取整；传统命理以立春为界，如需严格口径请自行按立春调整。: This tool uses the Gregorian year. Traditional reckoning changes at the Start of Spring; adjust accordingly for strict use.
map.仅收录部分代表性事件，并非 exhaustive；严谨考据请查权威史料或专业数据: Only representative events are included, not an exhaustive list. Use authoritative sources or historical databases for rigorous research.
